utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’m coming, and I can bring a few tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — bring whatever basic tools you’ve got, and I’ll sort out the rest when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the basics and head over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — that would be a big help. If you can keep track of pickups, I’ll sort the tools and see what spare parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning works for me — I’ll keep track of the pickups so nothing gets missed. We still need a few tools and spare parts, too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ll sort through the tools and check what spare parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up—sounds like Mara’s waiting on the broken items and names, and maybe Saturday around 10 a.m. could work. Is that still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s still the plan — once the broken items and names are in, we can lock in Saturday at 10. I’m still waiting on that list, then we’re good to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass along that we still need the broken items and names. Saturday at 10 sounds good once the list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’m still keeping things low-key, but I’ll help where I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. Did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, sorry — I’m still keeping things low-key, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning at 10 works for me too — I’ll check what’s new and get back to you if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — that sounds good. Let me know what’s still needed and I’ll help around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading there now to confirm the exact room for the repair drive, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll keep everyone posted while you confirm it. Send me the room as soon as you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m on it now and I’ll send the exact room as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send over the broken items and names once I have them. That should make it easier to get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — send them over when you can, and I’ll help where I can at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — I’ll get that list together and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we still need that clear list of broken stuff and who’s taking each job before it really gets rolling.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort the broken stuff and I’m still good to take the fence if that’s open.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — that’d be a big help. The fence is still open, so I’ll put your name on it and start the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve nearly finished the list, Rey—I’ll bring over what’s still missing for the repair drive as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. Just let me know what’s left and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let folks know the list is nearly ready. If you hear of anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Vik—I’ll send anyone I can your way. Just let me know what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — first I’m waiting on Cleo’s missing items, then I’ll pass the list along and keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just bring the toolbox and we’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll point you to the fence fix too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just to confirm, are you definitely coming to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’m coming to the repair drive — I’ll be there and keep spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you know the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I can check and let you know as soon as I hear. I’m still planning to bring my tools either way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Eli — I’m ready to help as soon as you send over the broken items and names.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara. I’ll send them over as soon as I’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Eli — just send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll help get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll point you to the fence fix too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m mainly trying to sort out what still needs doing and who’s bringing what before we start. If there’s a list, send it my way and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll send over the list as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep nudging folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m checking for the first urgent repair now, Jules, and I’ll send it your way. If anything else pops up, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — send the first urgent one my way and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’m on it and will send the first urgent repair over as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. If you can help spread the word and maybe bring any spare screws or basic tools, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that—I'll spread the word and check my toolbox for screws and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey—that means a lot. I’ll keep things simple and be there when I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too—do you have the list of what’s broken and who’s handling each job?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I don’t have the full list on me, sorry—if you tell me the first broken thing, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — you are definitely coming to the repair drive this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive this weekend—thanks. If you can, bring the tools and any spare screws, and I’ll sort through them when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, good — I’ll bring the tools and spare screws. See you this weekend at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Opal. I’ll finish the list and have it ready when you get back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on my way to the community center now to check the exact room, and I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Opal. I’ll have the list ready when you get back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the missing items, and I’ll bring what I can to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the missing items over right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the list and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list updated. If you know of any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and send any homes your way. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Ira — see you Sunday at the community center.
